children: Meta Platforms (META, Financials) is giving its Muse AI a bigger job: helping run a business.
The company introduced Muse for Small Business on Tuesday, expanding its AI agent with new capabilities and connections to business apps.

Instead of asking Muse to complete individual tasks, small businesses can give it broader goals, such as helping manage their operations. The agent can then use its available tools and integrations to work toward those goals.
That expands Meta's ambitions well beyond consumer AI.

The company has been building Muse into a broader enterprise platform, with tools aimed at developers and larger companies. Adding small businesses brings Meta closer to software markets already served by companies such as Salesforce, Intuit and Shopify.
The push also shows how Meta is trying to turn increasingly autonomous AI agents into practical business tools rather than simply assistants that answer questions.
For investors, the next test is whether businesses actually adopt Muse for everyday work, giving Meta another path to turn its heavy AI spending into products companies are willing to use.

title: Meta Wants Its AI to Help Run Your Business
